purpose: Starts an action shown by a single icon with no visible label, as a square at the Button heights. Use it in toolbars, table rows and dialog headers where the icon is unambiguous.

notFor.case: The action needs words to be understood.
Dismissing an alert, toast, dialog or tag with an X.
The one primary action that floats over the screen's content.

Default.visual: The same Variant x Appearance roles as Button: Action/primary/default with Content/on-action, Action/secondary/default with Content/on-secondary, Status/critical/surface-solid with Status/critical/on-solid; outline edges Border/accent or Status/critical/border-strong.

Hover.visual: Fills move to their hover role (Action/primary/hover, Action/secondary/hover, Action/ghost/hover, Status/critical/surface-solid-hover, Status/critical/surface); link ink to Content/link/hover.

Pressed.visual: Fills move to their pressed role (Action/primary/pressed, Action/secondary/pressed, Action/ghost/pressed, Status/critical/surface-solid-pressed, Status/critical/surface-pressed).

Focused.visual: The Default look plus a ring: Border/ring/default, Border/ring/neutral or Status/critical/ring by Variant.

Loading.visual: The Default look with a spinner in place of the icon.

Disabled.visual: Action/disabled/default fill, Border/control edge, Content/disabled ink.

a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches it; Enter or Space activates it (native button).
notes: aria-label is required (no visible text); it must include the count when the badge shows one.
Disabled sets aria-disabled; Loading sets aria-busy.
Colours move with the motion role use-hover; the focus ring with use-focus.

openQuestions: Reduced motion: should the hover and press transitions (use-hover, including the scale) be dropped, or only shortened?
Badge: is the badge's count announced only through the aria-label, or should the badge part be exposed to assistive tech too?
IconButton has no human contract (design-plans/icon-button-contract.md does not exist). Should one be written, or does button-contract.md cover it?
